title: Peninsula Studio Trail: open studios
summary: Meet artists in their working studios on 21-22 and 28-29 November, 10am-5pm. Individual studio opening dates vary, so check your chosen stops before travelling.
venueName: Participating artist studios across Mornington Peninsula Shire
recurrenceNote: 21-22 and 28-29 November 2026, 10am-5pm. Check each studio's opening dates.
verificationNote: Programme dates and hours checked against the organiser on 17 November 2026. Single organiser provenance chain; independent editorial review and release acceptance are separate. Individual-site arrangements, admission and availability are not verified.
editorNote:
Peninsula Studio Trail's open weekends are a chance to see work in progress and talk with artists in their working studios. The organiser lists programme dates of 21-22 and 28-29 November 2026, from 10am to 5pm. They are four separate open days, not a continuous event between the two weekends.

Plan a small group of stops using the organiser's artist map and profiles. Some studios open only on selected dates, and some are closed. Check the artists you want to visit before travelling. This listing covers studios within Mornington Peninsula Shire; the organiser's wider map also includes Frankston locations outside that scope. There is no single arrival address for this programme.
provenance: Original PI editorial draft from current organiser information. Held for regional discovery support, independent exact-candidate review and rendered release checks. No automated scan or publication receipt claimed.
